notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/6c57a05eab4dc61e8c8835f846df4c67c2b67c35.png[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.0.7:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new cop named Guildenstern (because of course!)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused cops who die or get injured during the last day to participate in the final mission
[*] Difficulty level for the final mission tweaked a bit
[*] Now you can proceed with your gang investigation right away even when you have interrogated/tortured your informant after 01:00
[*] Some other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Now you can get rid of cops you hate!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/253062f113d750c2cc34d70064f48d2a221c0e97.png[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.0.4 Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now you are able to send cops that drive you crazy back to Lilly, but be careful: you won't get free substitutes!
[*]Added a new SAFE mode for video playback, to solve the crashes some players had - available through the settings in the main menu.
[*]Fixed an issue with assault that has been forfeited
[*]Fixed an issue with putting lootboxes on the safezone
[*]Fixed an issue in torture screen
[*]Music in tactics will respect volume set in the options
[*]Changed volume curve in options to better represent the changes in loudness
[*]Fixed a rare crash that would block the progress on morning shift screen
[*]Some other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/eb093b67d23bc8e44eee3e68d8a461955fab289a.png[/img]

[h1]Change log:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where cops could get stuck on a call after finishing tactical missions
[*]Fixed a very rare bug about a specific good looking cop that would block the game in later stages
[*]Fixed the assault if player forfeits it
[*]Some changes to assault UI to make it less confusing
[*]Preserve the selected perks if a tactical mission is restarted
[*]Minor changes to balance
[*]Some other minor changes and fixes
[/list]

We are also aware of the video playback issue when the game stops working during cutscenes and will fix it in the next update. 
As a bonus we are in the middle of implementing a mode for those who wants the game to be more challenging.

notes.title: Trading Cards and big balance update now available!
notes.content:
Dear This Is the Police community,

we are happy to announce that we have just activated Trading Cards on the game! Hope you like that.

In addition to that, for all who have not noticed, yesterday evening a big balance update (patch 1.0.2) has been released. Being a cop shouldn't be that hard, right? Check out the changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/games/785740/announcements/detail/1697180487041378491
Stay tuned
Your THQ Nordic Team

tags.feature: we are happy to announce that we have just activated Trading Cards on the game!

notes.title: Big Balance Improvements: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/dd6571edb078118e33b1101ddc81dbc221783fb6.png[/img]
Hey guys!
Thank you all so much for your feedback. We’re working hard to address all the issues and to make the game more fun to play. In this update we’ve made a lot of balance improvements, we hope you’ll enjoy them. 
[list]
[*]You get rewarded more for arresting criminals and punished less for missing them. 
[*]Professionalism requirements are lower for all missions now
[*]You starting team of cops is much better now
[*]Your cops don’t lose stamina points just for coming in to work, only for actually doing something
[*]Your cops fully recover their stamina after a day off
[*]Your cops don’t lose stamina points for responding to false alarms
[*]Tab prices for cops and equipments are revised
[*]Your cops don’t come up with excuses and stay home as often as they used to
[*]Your cops don’t drink as much as they used to (weird, right?)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes an issue in investigation screen that would result in duplicated frames and block progress
[*]Some fixes to text
[/list]

[h1]Installing the update on macOS:[/h1]
if you are getting an error message while launching the game, you need to remove and reinstall the game. This seems to be an issue caused by Steam client on macOS.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/8d2821f595557905b3944b3a923bc08da037d3ff.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone. We're trying to fix issues people have with the game as soon as possible. Here's the first patch with fixes:

[h1] Patch Notes: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a serious bug blocking the gameplay in the first investigation if played on Chinese or Japanese language
    [*]Fixed mouse input on PCs with touchscreen
    [*]Changes to game balance
    [*]Fixed a glitch that would cause double items in storage
    [*]Some fixes to Chinese, Japanese and Korean text rendering, like bigger font for tutorials
[/list]

[h1] Balance Improvements: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Your starting team of cops is better now
[*] Professionalism requirement for calls is lowered for the first week (and for some other portions of the game)
[*] The game punishes you less for escaped offenders, killed civilians and skipped tactical missions
[*] The game rewards you more for closed investigations and destroyed gangs
[/list]
